Fee (INDICATIVE) $<n> [per year] <year> indicative annual fee" (certificates show the 40 CP annual figure without "per year"). Start terms also read from the degree-structure selector ("Select when you are planning to start studying ... Trimester 1 Trimester 2") and "Next intake Trimester n <year>". Trimester to month = orientation month, from Griffith academic calendar (https://www.griffith.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0036/1475757/2027-Academic-Calendar.pdf, 2026 version /0034/1475755/) and the course pages ("Trimester 1 2027 Orientation commences 22 February 2027", "Trimester 3 2026 Orientation commences 26 October 2026"): Trimester 1 = February, Trimester 2 = July (orientation 6-10 July 2026, 5-9 July 2027), Trimester 3 = October. Keys "1, 2"/"2, 3"/"1, 3" only expand the page list form "Trimester 1, 2, 3".
